title: Ellaz turn rules file
description: Every timing of the turn machine, in TICKS at `tickRate`. The demo these came from (2026-09-13) waited in seconds; at 60 ticks a second 0.2 s is 12 ticks. Nothing here is a pixel except `floatRise`, the height a damage float climbs over its life.

tickRate.description: ticks per second; the engine steps at 60

strikeWindupTicks.description: from the swing to the damage landing

strikeRecoverTicks.description: from the damage to the striker settling

enemyBannerTicks.description: the pause after ENEMY TURN shows before the first enemy acts

betweenTicks.description: between one enemy's action and the next

turnBannerTicks.description: how long YOUR TURN and ENEMY TURN stay up

firstBannerTicks.description: the first YOUR TURN of a battle

floatRise.description: view px a float climbs over its life
